## Setup
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)   # for percent_format()

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v5")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "downstream-analyses")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "input")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))
```

## Load data
```{r load-seurat-object}
obj <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "cart_annotated.rds"))
```

## Visualize top 3 markers per lineage in a single dot plot
```{r visualize-top-markers-dotplot}
lineage_markers <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "cart_lineage_markers.csv"))

# Select top 3 markers per lineage based on avg_log2FC
top3_markers <- lineage_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 3)

# Preserve ordering by lineage
top3_markers <- top3_markers %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

features_to_plot <- top3_markers$gene

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "cart_dotplot_top_lineage_markers.pdf"),
    width = 14, height = 6)

p <- DotPlot(
  obj,
  features = features_to_plot,
  cols = "RdYlBu",
  group.by = "cell_type",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  ggtitle("Top 3 Markers per Lineage") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p)
dev.off()
```

## Lineage stacked barplot
```{r lineage-stacked-barplot}
meta <- as.data.frame(obj@meta.data)
prop_df <- meta %>%
  dplyr::count(condition, cell_type) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# Save proportions
write.table(
  prop_df,
  file = file.path(results_dir, "cart_lineage_proportions.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = condition, y = prop, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = DiscretePalette(n = length(unique(prop_df$cell_type)))
  ) +
  labs(fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  xlab("Condition") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format())

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "cart_lineage_proportions_stacked_barplot.png"), width = 8, height = 5)
```
